utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it from Sam, so I might have it wrong, but I think they’re still collecting this weekend—have you heard anything more definite?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to it too, but last I heard they were still treating it as the working plan for this weekend and doing one final check before announcing anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds about like what I’d heard too—thanks. I’ll wait for the final word from Sam before I plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m just waiting to confirm Faye’s exact midday window, and then I’ll pass it straight along so we can lock her in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—once Faye confirms her midday window, send it to me and I’ll log her timing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — as soon as Faye confirms that midday window between school pickup and drop-off, I’ll send it over so you can log her in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got the drill, sawhorses, and level, and I’ll have them there by eight so setup’s easy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, perfect—thanks, Gus. I keep losing track, but having the drill, sawhorses, and level there by eight helps a ton.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Noah—I’ll bring the drill, sawhorses, and level by eight, so you can count on that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that sounds right, and I’m glad you’re checking with Mara because I keep second-guessing what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem—I’ll check with Mara about the volunteers, the small appliances table, and the bikes, and I’ll keep telling folks Cleo’s in to track tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you—that takes a load off. I think that covers the main gaps, unless I’m forgetting something again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m set for check-in at 9:30, and I’ll keep track of the tools and supplies people bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good—can you confirm who besides Bo actually shows up with tools once people check in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep—I’ll note who brings tools as they check in, so I can confirm besides Bo once folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still spreading the word fast for the repair drive, and even a short stop-in or a handy friend makes a real difference.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—I still haven’t heard the final count, but last I heard they’re starting with the porch steps and fence, and Mina probably knows the latest on timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good to know—I’ll check with Mina on the timing and supplies, and I’ll keep nudging folks to swing by if they can help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need two fix-it table helpers and one check-in person, and volunteers should be there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, but let’s confirm those roles tonight and remind everyone about the 9:30 arrival so we’re not scrambling in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—I’ll confirm the two table helpers and one check-in spot tonight, and remind everyone to be there by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard they’re still doing the repair drive supply collection this weekend, but I’m checking with Sam to confirm the timing so we don’t send anyone over at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for checking that—while you confirm the timing with Sam, can we also do one last check that the repair drive list is still small home fixes, bike repairs, and basic electronics?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that still matches what I’ve heard, but I’ll confirm the list with Sam too so we’re not passing along anything outdated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we’re still looking for two fix-it table helpers who can arrive by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for the update—I can help at one of the fix-it tables for a bit; do you know who’s coordinating volunteers now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. I’m still coordinating volunteers, and with you we just need one more fix-it table helper for Sunday at the community center by 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve been telling folks the priorities are extension cords, power strips, screwdrivers, and spare parts first, so the repair drive’s starting to come together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good. I can swing by for a little while and bring a screwdriver, but I’d rather keep to the edge of things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Uli—a screwdriver still helps, and you can stay on the sidelines as much as you like. I’ll keep spreading the word about the extension cords, power strips, and spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then let’s ask Sam directly—when’s the supply list getting finalized, and do they want extra lumber for the porch steps or not?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the right next step—if Sam can lock the supply list down tonight, we’ll know by eight whether to set out extra lumber for the porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you check with Sam tonight and tell me by eight if we’re setting out extra lumber, and whether the porch steps are definitely first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still in—just send me the basics on what needs fixing and who’s bringing tools, and I’ll show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo—I’m checking the folding tables and tool bins first, then I’ll confirm what needs fixing and ask Opal who besides you is bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the basics once you’ve got them, and I’ll plan on bringing my toolbox if you still need it.
